candidate.title: Admin embedding route calls store.find without an id, causing findAll-style parsing and an empty model
reports: [bug] show renders the singleton under the singular root key 'embedding', but the route loads it with store.find('embedding') (no id), which the store routes to findall, and findall extracts the collection from the plural root key ('embeddings' — the shape the fruit findall fixture added in this diff exercises), so the model load resolves to nothing or garbage. the admin embedding page's model never becomes the expected record: the host table never renders ({{if embedding.embeddablehosts}} stays falsy) and the add host button throws on undefined.pushobject, leaving the pr's primary screen dead for admins.
